Xenazine (tetrabenazine) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-716192  
Guideline Name 
Xenazine (tetrabenazine)  
Formulary 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
10/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Preferred: generic tetrabenazine; Non-Preferred: Brand Xenazine  
Diagnosis 
Chorea associated with Huntington’s Disease  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of chorea in patients with Huntington’s disease  
 
AND 


--- PDF page 2036 ---
Page 2036 
 
2 - For Brand Xenazine requests ONLY: History of failure or intolerance to generic 
tetrabenazine  
 
Product Name:Preferred: generic tetrabenazine; Non-Preferred: Brand Xenazine  
Diagnosis 
Tardive Dyskinesia (Off Label)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of tardive dyskinesia  
 
AND 
 
2 - One of the following:  
 
 2.1 Patient has persistent symptoms of tardive dyskinesia despite a trial of dose reduction, 
tapering, or discontinuation of the offending medication  
 
OR 
 
 2.2 Patient is not a candidate for a trial of dose reduction, tapering, or discontinuation of the 
offending medication  
 
AND 
 
3 - Prescribed by or in consultation with one of the following:  
Neurologist  
Psychiatrist  


--- PDF page 2037 ---
Page 2037 
 
AND 
 
4 - For Brand Xenazine requests ONLY: History of failure or intolerance to generic 
tetrabenazine  
 
Product Name:Preferred: generic tetrabenazine; Non-Preferred: Brand Xenazine  
Diagnosis 
Tardive Dyskinesia (Off Label)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Documentation of positive clinical response to therapy  
 
AND 
 
2 - For Brand Xenazine requests ONLY: History of failure or intolerance to generic 
tetrabenazine  
 
Product Name:Preferred: generic tetrabenazine; Non-Preferred: Brand Xenazine  
Diagnosis 
Tourette’s syndrome (off-label)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Patient has tics associated with Tourette’s syndrome

AND 
 
2 - History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to Haldol (haloperidol)

Psychiatrist  
 
AND 
 
4 - For Brand Xenazine requests ONLY: History of failure or intolerance to generic 
tetrabenazine
